cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. At the staff barbecue, introduce me as Director Patel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm introducing everyone by first name. Even the owner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then give me a separate introduction when I welcome the staff.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner's doing the welcome. You offered to serve burgers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce the burger service: 'Director Patel will serve you.' I'd like them to hear who's making this gesture.
